endorsements.quote: Instead, they should maintain a measurement record documenting the construct definition and rationale, Page 20/46 selected indicators, validity evidence, assumptions, uncertainties and contextual basis for thresholds.

unlisted_practices: Organizations should not treat a single ethical metric as evidence that an AI system is ethical.

Standardization of ethical AI assessment should prioritize transparent measurement procedures, validity requirements, reporting practice and contextual justification rather than any single universal metric.

Organizations should accompany AI systems with a construct validity statement recording the construct definition, stakeholders and context, construct-to-indicator mapping, validity and reliability evidence, measurement uncertainty, transferability limitations, and system version and date.
Evaluators should define fairness, transparency and explainability constructs for the specific application before selecting indicators or metrics.

screen.reason: The paper proposes a conceptual and construct validity framework for measuring and auditing ethical AI (fairness, transparency, explainability) across organizations and standards, illustrated via a hypothetical clinical decision-support system.
